stage: A0 plus stationary A1; no replay or control claim

label.name: smoothed_loading_rise_n
label.definition: max over completed 20 ms interval of positive (causal 10 ms average force magnitude minus that average 10 ms earlier)
label.interpretation: finite-bandwidth rapid normal loading proxy; not collision energy or physical damage

budget_amendment: Extended from 20k to 60k after validation curves still improved; before test evaluation
validation_roles: env index modulo 3: 0 model selection, 1 calibration, 2 alarm operating point; all are distinct from train/test geometry seeds

event.matching: alarm interval must overlap a merged same-foot truth event; no relaxed future tolerance

checkpoint_selection: lowest held-out selection-set own training objective, calibrated on separate episodes after selection
convergence: report full validation curve and best-step position; maximum steps alone is not convergence proof
test_policy: evaluate once after fitting/calibration; no model or label changes from test scores
scope_limit: five optimization seeds on one training collection seed; not five independent data replications
